question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.**

Too strong to be defeated or changed
solution:
The correct answer is: **Invincible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Invincible **means too strong to be defeated or overcome. (अपराजेय)
 
• It comes from the Latin word "vincere" which means to conquer or overcome.
 
 
• **Example**: *The superhero's incredible strength and resilience made them feel almost invincible when facing their arch-nemesis.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Headstrong **means stubborn and unwilling to change one's mind or course of action. (ज़िद्दी)
 
• **Vigorous **means strong, healthy, and full of energy. (ज़ोरदार)
 
• **Sovereign **means having supreme power or authority. (सार्वभौम)
